status: Frozen methods for a model-free diagnostic on retained native teacher scores; not an adoption, FIT teacher pass, KD execution or issue164 disposition
decision_question: On exact shared support-complete frames of two already-exposed DEV prefixes, does retained native F16 teacher provide stronger source-global speaker information than actual BCE-selected 390 and contrast-selected 780?

methods.identity_first: Prefix/PCM identity uses retained cost receipts plus exact int16/32768 sample equality against prepared waveforms; file names are insufficient.
methods.teacher_decode: Little-endian float32 row-major diar.probs.f32 is the score tensor. Native events must cover the same rows with contiguous emit_start_frame/count. JSON decimal probs are checked within 1e-6 and are not used for scores. Metadata/dump are asserted strict 0<p<1, then float64 log(p)-log1p(-p) with no clip or temperature.
methods.common_mask: Intersect GT activity validity with emitted teacher rows whose recorded chunk raw_support_end_sample lies within both n_visible and the prefix. Missing, tail and support-incomplete rows are excluded and counted. One shared common-valid mask is constructed once per source and reused for every arm. Activity BCE/Brier and 0.5 counts use this common support-complete mask; full-prefix GT-valid counts are reported separately and are not that denominator.
methods.association: Raw column indices are an explicitly unverified-index diagnostic. Primary comparison uses one fixed source-global 24-permutation oracle per arm, maximizing that arm's balanced argmax accuracy with lexicographic tie-break, then reused only for that same arm's mapped conditional and independent-activity scores. A teacher permutation is not shared onto independent student heads. Not causal association, per-chunk remapping, checkpoint selection or training targets.
methods.activity: Independent BCE/Brier on common-valid fractional GT. At fixed 0.5, predicted active-count distribution on common-valid frames and correctly mapped single-active fraction on strict-solo GT.
methods.baselines: Same-seed retained untrained logits, constant FIT occupancy prior, and uniform four-slot logits, rescored on the common mask. No FIT teacher common-logit control exists.
methods.horizon: Teacher has chunk-level future support. 9056 is the conservative chunk-level interior last-bin support excess, not exact per-row lookahead; earlier bins in the same emission have more future. Student has zero target-relative future. Not matched-causality, live 80ms, admission or speed evidence.
methods.numerics: CPU float64; no bootstrap, significance, generalization or fitted teacher temperature/clipping.

limitations: Correlated 80ms frames and two already-exposed DEV prefixes do not support statistical generalization or significance claims.
Oracle mapping is one source-global permutation per arm, not a shared teacher-to-student column identity, not proof that FIT teacher association is valid, and not a human-slot identity.
Teacher future horizon differs from the causal student; 9056 is conservative chunk support, not per-row lookahead, and this is not matched-causality or admission evidence.
No FIT teacher scores exist; none were fitted on DEV.
This diagnostic does not authorize a FIT teacher pass, KD execution or production-policy change.

ES native_teacher mapped class-balanced conditional NLL is worse than uniform on the same common mask, and the 11-frame observed class has recall 0. That is contrary rare-class evidence, not a reason to dismiss class-balanced scoring. EN teacher class-balanced NLL is much better. No universal teacher-quality claim.

support.recorded_raw_support_rule: chunk raw_support_end_sample <= n_visible and <= prefix; applied to every emitted row in that chunk
chunk raw_support_end_sample <= n_visible and <= prefix; applied to every emitted row in that chunk

remaining_uncertainty: Speaker-sensitive scores may still be confounded by occupancy, channel, source or non-identity temporal structure.
Native columns are not established human identities even after a per-arm source-global oracle permutation.
DEV evidence is two already-exposed prefixes only.
ES class-balanced teacher NLL being worse than uniform is retained contrary evidence on the rare class; it does not overturn the common-mask construction or authorize a quality claim.
